Heavy Rains Cause Disruption Across India, IMD Issues Alerts

Several Indian states are experiencing severe weather conditions due to heavy monsoon rains, leading to waterlogging, landslides, and damage to property. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued alerts for various regions, warning of thunderstorms and heavy rainfall. The extreme weather has disrupted transportation and caused significant losses, with some reports linking these patterns to climate change.
